CONFIDENTIALITY UNDERTAKING
Synthetic test document. Fictional parties. No legal effect.
4.1 Obligation. Each Party shall keep the other Party's Confidential Information strictly confidential and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.
4.2 Exceptions. Clause 4.1 does not apply to information that is or becomes public other than through breach of this Agreement or that is required to be disclosed by law.
